name: Entra ID and Microsoft Graph error-code lab runs
description: Every automated lab run recorded in data/lab-runs/ of the site repository: the scenario sent, the code expected, the code returned and the first line of the message as returned. Identifiers from the lab tenant (tenant id, app and object ids, addresses) are replaced with placeholders such as {tenant-id}.
semantics: Append-only: a run is never edited after the fact; a later run is a new record with its own date. A result is a measurement on that date and can differ from a later run.
